Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: two published faces move. (1) `TableColumn` in `@object-ui/types` takes one optional member, `chips?: boolean`, mirrored in zod and tombstoned on the static `table` surface, because the table cannot otherwise tell a chip column from text. (2) `@object-ui/components`' entry (`export * from './custom'`) exports the one shared overflow box, because its consumers sit in other packages: `HorizontalOverflowBox` and its props type (`plugin-grid`'s grouped scroller, the console's Approvals Inbox) and `PINNED_RIGHT_SEAM_SHADOW_CLASSES` (`plugin-grid`'s pinned Actions cells). Only those names are exported; helpers no other package reads stay module-internal. The seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review comes before ready.
